# Slide decks {.unnumbered}

The revealjs slide decks for presenting the session. Each deck is a single
self-contained HTML file — open in a browser, use arrow keys to navigate,
`f` for fullscreen, `o` for slide overview.

- [B3_1 slides: odin basics & the SIR model](slides/slides-01-odin-basics-sir.html)
- [B3_2 slides: extending models — SEIR, demography & time-varying parameters](slides/slides-02-extending-models.html)

The book chapters (@sec-lecture1 and @sec-lecture2) cover the same material
with full notes, exercises and solutions.
